g.text: Identify — you, patient (2 identifiers), role, location
"This is Ama, RGN, Ward B — Kofi Mensah, 68, Bed 4, post-op day 1..."
"BP 85/50, HR 128, drain 400 mL blood in 1 h — I need you NOW..."
Background — relevant history, obs trend, treatment so far
"Laparotomy yesterday, was stable, 2 L in, 300 out, Hb was 11..."
"I think he's bleeding internally — rigid abdomen, restless, pale..."
Recommendation + Read-back — what you need + confirm
"Come now + bloods + crossmatch 4 — read back: coming, crossmatch 4, 10:42..."

svg.text: INCIDENT CHAIN: detect → make safe → inform → form → disclose → learn
Make safe FIRST (patient stable, spill contained, drug stopped) → inform in-charge +
doctor → incident form SAME SHIFT (facts, no blame, no \"caused by\") → open
disclosure to patient/family (what, harm, next steps, apology, contact) → debrief +
reflection + system fix tracked. Bedside handover: patient IN it (consent, introduce,
invite corrections, curtains for sensitive) — safer + shorter + trusted. Never hand
over what you haven't verified; never accept what you haven't questioned.
Staffing-unsafe? Escalate IN WRITING (in-charge → management), prioritize visibly,
document — verbal warnings evaporate at tribunals.
